description: This file defines a report class for VAT audit, including methods to fetch invoice data, calculate tax details, and generate report data for purchase and sales invoices within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: VATAuditReport
classes.description: Class responsible for generating VAT audit report, including data retrieval, processing, and formatting for purchase and sales invoices.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function that initializes and runs the VAT audit report with optional filters.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the report with filters, columns, data, and document types.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to generate report data by fetching VAT accounts, invoice data, and processing for each document type.

methods.name: get_sa_vat_accounts
methods.description: Fetches South Africa VAT accounts based on the company filter; throws error if not configured.

methods.name: get_invoice_data
methods.description: Retrieves invoice data for a given doctype based on filters and conditions.

methods.name: get_invoice_items
methods.description: Fetches invoice items related to the retrieved invoices.

methods.name: get_items_based_on_tax_rate
methods.description: Calculates tax details and categorizes items based on tax rates, focusing on South Africa VAT accounts.

methods.name: get_item_amount_map
methods.description: Calculates and returns amount details for an item, including tax rate, gross, net, and tax amounts.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions string based on filters like company, date range.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Generates consolidated report data grouped by tax rates for each invoice type.

methods.name: get_consolidated_data
methods.description: Consolidates invoice data into sections based on tax rates for report output.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns structure for the report.
